d:
Jharkhand men chhath mahaparv ki dhum dekhne ko mil rahi hai. shahar se lekar ganv tak har taraph chhath ka utsah aur bhakti ka mahaul hai. bajaron men puja samagri ki kharidari, gharon men taiyariyan aur chhath ghaton par saph-saphaee va sajavat ne parv ki raunak barha di hai.
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar shraddhaluon men khas utsah hai. char dinon tak chalne vale is parv men vrati bhagvan sury aur chhathi maiya ki aaradhna karte hain. dekhie jharkhand men chhath ki taiyariyon aur utsav ki khas tasviren.
Jharkhand aur desh ki har bari khabar ke lie hamare chainal se jure rahen.
